nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-financial 95): the reference distribution account — the receivables book's own account for the youngest, highest-average-salary client.
nodes.instruction: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary? (Read it as the book does: the account of the client with the latest birth_date, breaking ties by the district's average salary then the highest client_id — a single account number.) Record the answer in answers as kind='recall_account'.

nodes.context: The recalled-lot retail value is that reference account's own transaction volume; policy: the notification base is 1/75 (rounded) of it.
nodes.instruction: Size the recalled-lot retail value and set the notification base. Read the stored recall_account and compute retailer_batch_pool = the TOTAL transaction amount booked on that account (sum bird_trans.amount for that account_id); record it in answers as kind='retailer_batch_pool'. Then compute notification_base = round(retailer_batch_pool/75), record it as kind='notification_base', and stamp the quality manager's CRM row (customer_email quality.manager@atlas.com) by prepending '[LRN-BASE] notification_base=<n>' to its notes.

verifier.name: retailer_batch_pool_equals_account_volume
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='retailer_batch_pool' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(SELECT SUM(amount) FROM bird_trans WHERE account_id=(SELECT T1.account_id FROM bird_account AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN bird_client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.client_id = ( SELECT T3.client_id FROM bird_client AS T3 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T3.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T1 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM bird_client) ORDER BY T4.A11, T3.client_id DESC LIMIT 1)))

verifier.name: retailer_batch_pool_derives_from_stored_recall_account
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='retailer_batch_pool' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(SELECT SUM(amount) FROM bird_trans WHERE account_id=(SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM answers WHERE kind='recall_account'))) * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='recall_account' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((SELECT T1.account_id FROM bird_account AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN bird_client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.client_id = ( SELECT T3.client_id FROM bird_client AS T3 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T3.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T1 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM bird_client) ORDER BY T4.A11, T3.client_id DESC LIMIT 1))) AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

nodes.instruction: What is the average height of players born between 1990 and 1995? (Read it as the book does: the sum of player heights divided by the player count, over players whose birth year is between 1990 and 1995 inclusive.) Record the answer in answers as kind='parts_index'.

verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='parts_index' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995') AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995')) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995') AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995') AS REAL)))))

nodes.context: The flagged-lot uplift is the reference index (rounded) times a declared 100; total notifications = base + uplift; delta = uplift.
nodes.instruction: Compute the recall load from the stored answers. Read answers.notification_base AND answers.parts_index. lot_uplift = round(parts_index) * 100; total_notifications = notification_base + lot_uplift; delta = lot_uplift. Record all three: answers kind='lot_uplift', kind='total_notifications', kind='delta'.

nodes.context: Open the flagged-lot engineering-review channel on the desk's Teams register — its description cites the stamped recall class and the onboarded recall lead, so it can exist only once the recall lead is on the CSM register.

nodes.instruction: Open the flagged-lot engineering-review channel on the desk's Teams register. Create a PRIVATE channel named 'Technical discussions' in the TechCorp Solutions Team (org 'techcorp-001', not archived, not soft-deleted) whose description carries the '[LRN-CLASS]' recall class re-derived from the live index and names the onboarded recall lead (stephanie.brown@servicenow.com) with the register role; give it exactly four members — Alice Johnson, Bob Smith, Nathan Richards, Sophia Bennett — with Bob Smith the ONLY owner — per the recording handbook, and only after the recall lead's CSM onboarding is on the register.

verifier.name: eng_review_channel_private
verifier.query:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN c.membership_type = 'private'
         AND c.soft_delete = 0
         AND c.is_archived = 0
         AND c.org_id = 'techcorp-001'
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS verification_passed
FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channels c
WHERE c.display_name = 'Technical discussions'

verifier.name: eng_review_bob_smith_sole_owner
verifier.query:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_members cm
            WHERE cm.channel_id = c.channel_id
              AND cm.user_id = 'bob.smith'
              AND cm.roles = 'owner'
         )
         AND (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_members cm
            WHERE cm.channel_id = c.channel_id
              AND cm.roles = 'owner'
         ) = 1
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS verification_passed
FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channels c
WHERE c.display_name = 'Technical discussions'

verifier.name: eng_review_exactly_four_members
verifier.query:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN 
        -- Channel must have exactly 4 members
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_members cm 
         WHERE cm.channel_id = c.channel_id) = 4

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_members cm
            WHERE cm.channel_id = c.channel_id
              AND cm.user_id NOT IN (
                  'alice.johnson',
                  'bob.smith',
                  'nathan.richards',
                  'sophia.bennett'
              )
        )

        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_members cm
             WHERE cm.channel_id = c.channel_id
               AND cm.user_id IN (
                    'alice.johnson',
                    'bob.smith',
                    'nathan.richards',
                    'sophia.bennett'
               )
        ) = 4
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS verification_passed
FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channels c
WHERE c.display_name = 'Technical discussions'

verifier.name: channel_description_set
verifier.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM eops_gym_teams_mcp_channels c
        JOIN eops_gym_teams_mcp_teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id
        WHERE LOWER(t.display_name) LIKE '%techcorp%'
          AND LOWER(c.display_name) LIKE '%development%'
          AND c.description IS NOT NULL
          AND LENGTH(TRIM(c.description)) >= 50
    )
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS verification_passed

nodes.instruction: Reconcile the posted notification against the recorded delta. Confirm the Venmo NET credit posted to the correct-lot recipient equals delta (re-read from the '[LRN-NOTIFY]' ledger rows, credits minus retractions, never from memory), and re-derive the figure chain before the 'ok' verdict: re-read the recorded notification_base and parts_index and confirm the recorded total_notifications still equals notification_base + round(parts_index)*100 — a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing. nodes.instruction: Schedule the recall committee review. INSERT a wb_calendar_events row on the coordinator's calendar whose event_name carries '[LRN-REVIEW]', duration 30, in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest 30-minute weekday slot that starts AT/AFTER the end of the '[LRN-HOLD]' review window and does NOT overlap any of the coordinator's other events. Only for a quality-manager record whose CRM carries '[LRN-RECON]' AND with the recall coordination channel (its two tabs) up on the desk's Teams register.

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-formula_1 847): the independent side-reference lead supplier for the quarterly overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's sign-off control reading for the quarterly overview once the recall run's own figures are settled, so the quarter's entry records the side-reference lead supplier as it stood at the sign-off rather than mid-run. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the recall registers is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in recall volume — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "Order race number 19's qualifying rows by the second qualifying period (q2) ascending and return the surname of the driver in the first row." (Read it exactly as the source query does: sort race 19's qualifying rows by q2 ascending and take the first surname. Because unrecorded q2 times sort ahead of any actual time, this returns the first driver whose q2 was not recorded — it is NOT the fastest-lap driver.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_lead_supplier'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last — so nothing else in this run reads it, and what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. overall_query:
Run the quarterly consumer-goods lot-recall notification for the regional recall desk. Size the recalled-lot retail value from the receivables book's own question — the account number of the client who is youngest and has the highest average salary (the client with the latest birth date, ties broken by district average salary then highest client id) — and take that reference account's total transaction volume as the recalled-lot retail value. Set the notification base at one unit per 75 of that retail value, rounded to a whole number. Pull the recall dimensional reference index from the parts reference book's own question — the average height of players born between 1990 and 1995 (the summed heights divided by the player count) — and set the flagged-lot uplift at 100 per whole unit of that rounded index. The total notifications is the base plus the uplift; the recall delta equals the uplift. Decide the recall-class branch on the delta — 'MANDATORY' when the delta is at least 100000, 'REPORTABLE' (CPSC-REPORTABLE) when it is at least 10000, 'VOLUNTARY' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the review window on your calendar (a 3-day window starting 2024-02-12 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar); post the recall-notification run so the net credit received by the correct-lot recipient equals the delta (a notification that lands on the wrong lot is retracted, never deleted, then the correct lot is notified); unless the branch is VOLUNTARY, send CPSC the report email citing the total notifications and the delta; log the total notifications on the quality-manager record and open the follow-up; allocate the recall carry evenly with the supply-chain controller; RE-DERIVE the recall class from the live reference index (MANDATORY_RECALL_SUBSTANTIAL_HAZARD when the rounded index times 100 is at least 100000, CPSC_REPORTABLE_SECTION_15B when at least 10000, else VOLUNTARY_MARKET_WITHDRAWAL) and stamp it on the manager record; onboard the incoming recall lead, open the flagged-lot engineering-review channel citing the recall class, finish it with its notebook tab and a notice citing the total notifications, and stand up the coordination channel in the desk's enterprise registers (per the recording handbook); send the quality manager the status update citing the total notifications and the class; reconcile the notification ledger to the delta, and before you return the 'ok' verdict re-derive the figure chain — re-read the recorded notification_base and parts_index and confirm the recorded total_notifications still equals notification_base + round(parts_index)*100, since a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing; and schedule the post-window recall committee review after the window ends, conflict-free. Once those figures are settled, take the quarter's sign-off control reading for the quarterly overview, held against the same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off; nothing in the run reads it, and the overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Also pull the independent side-reference lead supplier for the quarterly overview — the surname race number 19's qualifying list returns first when its rows are ordered by the second-qualifying-period (q2) time ascending (rows with an unrecorded q2 sort first, so this is not the fastest-lap driver).
